import re

HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?P<severity>[A-Z]), \[(?P<timestamp>\S+) #(?P<pid>\d+)\]\s+(?P<level>[A-Z]+) -- :(?:\s+\[(?P<request_id>[^\]\s]+)\])?\s*(?P<message>.*?)\s*$")
CONT = re.compile(r"^\[(?P<request_id>[^\]\s]+)\]\s*(?P<message>.*?)\s*$")
STARTED = re.compile(r'^Started (?P<method>[A-Z]+) "(?P<path>[^"]*)" for (?P<client>\S+) at (?P<at>.+)$')
PROCESSING = re.compile(r"^Processing by (?P<controller>\S+)#(?P<action>\S+) as (?P<format>\S+)$")
PARAMS = re.compile(r"^Parameters: (?P<parameters>.*)$")
RENDERED = re.compile(r"^Rendered (?P<template>\S+)(?: within (?P<layout>\S+))? \((?P<stats>.*)\)$")
COMPLETED = re.compile(r"^Completed (?P<status>\d+) (?P<status_text>.*?) in (?P<duration>\S+)(?: \((?P<stats>.*)\))?$")
FRAME = re.compile(r"^(?P<file>\S+?):(?P<line>\d+):in [`'](?P<method>.*)'$")
STAT = re.compile(r"(\w+): ([\d.]+\w*)")

REQ_COLS = ["request_id", "pid", "started", "method", "path", "client", "controller", "action", "format",
            "parameters", "status", "status_text", "duration", "Views", "ActiveRecord", "Allocations",
            "error", "backtrace"]


def parse(lines):
    reqs, renders, events, frames = [], [], [], []
    used = {"requests": [], "renders": [], "events": [], "backtrace": []}
    byid = {}
    cur = None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = HEAD.match(ln) or CONT.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        d = m.groupdict()
        msg = d["message"]
        rid = d.get("request_id") or ""
        if d.get("timestamp") is None:
            # continuation line: exception text / backtrace frame of the request above
            cur = byid.get(rid, cur)
            if cur is None or not msg:
                if cur is not None:
                    used["requests"].append(j)
                continue
            f = FRAME.match(msg)
            if f:
                cur["frames"] = cur.get("frames", 0) + 1
                frames.append({"request_id": cur["request_id"], "frame": cur["frames"],
                               "file": f.group("file"), "line": f.group("line"), "method": f.group("method")})
                used["backtrace"].append(j)
                cur["backtrace"] = (cur["backtrace"] + ";" if cur["backtrace"] else "") + msg
            elif cur["error"] == "":
                cur["error"] = msg
                used["requests"].append(j)
            else:
                cur["error"] += " " + msg
                used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        s = STARTED.match(msg)
        if s or (rid and rid not in byid):
            cur = {k: "" for k in REQ_COLS}
            cur["request_id"] = rid
            cur["pid"] = d["pid"]
            cur["started"] = d["timestamp"]
            reqs.append(cur)
            if rid:
                byid[rid] = cur
        elif rid:
            cur = byid[rid]
        if cur is None:
            events.append({"request_id": rid, "timestamp": d["timestamp"], "pid": d["pid"], "level": d["level"], "message": msg})
            used["events"].append(j)
            continue
        if s:
            cur.update({"method": s.group("method"), "path": s.group("path"), "client": s.group("client")})
            used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        p = PROCESSING.match(msg)
        if p:
            cur.update({"controller": p.group("controller"), "action": p.group("action"), "format": p.group("format")})
            used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        p = PARAMS.match(msg)
        if p:
            cur["parameters"] = p.group("parameters")
            used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        r = RENDERED.match(msg)
        if r:
            rec = {"request_id": cur["request_id"], "template": r.group("template"), "layout": r.group("layout") or "",
                   "Duration": "", "Allocations": ""}
            for k, v in STAT.findall(r.group("stats")):
                rec[k] = v
            renders.append(rec)
            used["renders"].append(j)
            continue
        c = COMPLETED.match(msg)
        if c:
            cur.update({"status": c.group("status"), "status_text": c.group("status_text"), "duration": c.group("duration")})
            for k, v in STAT.findall(c.group("stats") or ""):
                if k in cur:
                    cur[k] = v
            used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        if not msg:
            used["requests"].append(j)
            continue
        events.append({"request_id": cur["request_id"], "timestamp": d["timestamp"], "pid": d["pid"], "level": d["level"], "message": msg})
        used["events"].append(j)
    for r in reqs:
        r.pop("frames", None)
    return [{"name": "requests", "kind": "table", "lines": used["requests"], "records": reqs},
            {"name": "renders", "kind": "table", "lines": used["renders"], "records": renders},
            {"name": "events", "kind": "table", "lines": used["events"], "records": events},
            {"name": "backtrace", "kind": "table", "lines": used["backtrace"], "records": frames}]
